reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: investment scram
reports.description: I received a call from a person from a trading company called Coral Trades. They said it would only cost $4000 and I could start making money with them. I agreed on this. So, the next day they called me and explained that the $3000 was only the registration fee and I would need to transfer more money. I agreed to a few thousand and we started trading. They would log into my computer via AnyDesk, so they had access to my computer and placed the trades, the first few weeks everything seemed fine my profits seemed to be going up and up. Then on Friday, they said they would not be in the next week and my account would be fine just leave everything the way it was. Then my account kept going into the red I kept losing money on the trades he had placed, $8000 from my personal trades disappeared. So, from being in profit I was in heavy loss. I contacted them via email within 15 min a manager from the support team rang me and started saying this should not have happened and they made mistakes etc, they would take over the account and recover all money lost and make me big money, but I had to invest more money. They wanted an extra $2000 USD, and they would make me a VIP I would get Gap events, I would get the best spreads, the best signals. So, I didn`t want to lose the money I had put in, so I agreed. Over the next few weeks the account got worse and once again the support team rang and this time, we had an argument I said I thought they were supposed to help me, they blamed the markets even myself, but not themselves, they again asked for more money to fix the account, this time I refused, so they threatened me in writing via a wire that they would destroy my account, they had a reputation, it would all crash in parts, they promised if I did not invest more money, in the end, they did this to me 2 times the 3rd time. I refused and closed the account. I have lost $16000 USD. These people especially Coral Trades have turned my life upside down.
